meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 检查你的记忆库云同步状态，或在 cmem.ai Pro 下配置同步：写入连接信息、重启 worker 并验证是否连通，最后汇报设备号、待同步数量、最近一次成功上传和错误。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」「sync my memories」「cmem pro」等，或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到自己的 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.text: 查一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 返回设备号、待同步数量和 Hub 连通情况
会向你要 cmem.ai 的三个连接值

say.text: 我的记忆同步失败了吗
say.note: 会报告 hub.error 或 lastError

howto.what_en: Checks your memory-database cloud sync status, or sets up cmem.ai Pro sync by writing the connection values, restarting the worker, and verifying it, then reporting device id, pending counts, last flush, and errors.
howto.when_en: Use when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "sync status" and similar, or want your memory database backed up to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts, Hub reachability
Asks for the three cmem.ai connection values
